Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Brittany and the girls release a video that Alvin, Simon, and Theodore can't top in 'Viral', and in 'Brothers of Dagarack', Simon asks Alvin and Theodore not to see a new movie without him.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to steal desserts from the school kitchen in 'The Underground', then in 'Game House', Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Miss Miller gets robbed in 'The Great Chipmunk Detective', and in 'Guitar Hero', Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she needs to learn.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin goes all out to make a new friend in 'Talking Teddy's Revenge', then in 'Snail-A-Palooza', Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, but things soon get real.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin agrees not to speak for 24 hours in 'Spoiler-Itis', then in 'Something's Fishy', when Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they try to replace it before he notices.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits in 'Missing Miss Smith', then in 'Monster Madness', Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off in 'He Said She Said', then in 'Attack of the Zombies', Alvin and Theodore try to protect their loved ones.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother in 'Big Bro Theodore', and in 'No Putts, No Glory', Alvin fools Theodore into believing he's good at mini golf which of course backfires.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Derek plans a wild party at Alvin's house in 'Animal House Party', then in 'Dr. Zap vs Electroboy', Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room in 'A Room of One's Own', then in 'Carts and Crafts', Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bicycle, so enters a contest to win a new bike.
